sources_used.source: NJTGO — Jamesburg Business & Shopping (local non-dining directory, reviewed Sept 2026)
BestProsInTown — Jamesburg business index and category pages
Google Maps searches centered on Jamesburg (plumber, electrician, HVAC, roofing, landscaping, tree service, painting, cleaning, pest control, auto repair, auto body, self storage, dentist)
Web search results citing BBB, SuperPages, YellowPages, Justia, BuildZoom, Macrae's, VerView, Cylex, WhereOrg, Nextdoor, Travelers agent locator, and company websites

categories_thin: Roofing, siding, windows, flooring, tree care, pools, restoration, security installers: map and directory searches returned only contractors headquartered in Monroe, East Brunswick or Spotswood; no roofing, tree-service or pool company appears to be based inside Jamesburg borough.

Gyms / fitness: only Hope Yoga, Innovative Wellness (training + yoga) and Kiryoku Training Center surfaced; no conventional gym in the borough (Snap Fitness at 198 Buckelew Ave was excluded as a franchise brand).
Photography studios and marketing/design agencies: none found with a Jamesburg address in any source.
Staffing and consulting firms: none found; professional services in town are dominated by law, accounting, insurance, title and real estate.
Dance/music schools: only Mozarts & Einsteins (music and dance lessons) plus a directory-only 'Stage Door Studio' listing.
Optometry and specialist medicine are concentrated in the 241/315/333 Forsgate Dr professional buildings.
caveats: Town-vs-ZIP ambiguity: Jamesburg's 08831 ZIP also covers much of Monroe Township, so businesses that Google/Maps directories label 'Jamesburg' may sit in Monroe (e.g., Rossmoor Dr, Centre Dr, Davidson's Mill Rd, Schoolhouse Rd, Old Forge Rd, Perrineville Rd, Englishtown Rd, Rhode Hall Rd addresses). Entries whose street may cross the borough line are flagged in notes; the triage team should confirm municipality before outreach.

Several law, accounting and medical entries come from a single bulk directory and may be stale (Conrad & Vincent, Richard Cerri, Leonard & Major, Zirrith, Kanter CPA, Warhaftig CPA, P.C. Patel MD, Brunswick Vision Care, Dubin Orthodontics).

Address conflicts: Ink Therapy (Willow St vs Forsgate Dr), Hulse Plumbing vs Hulse Family Kitchen & Bath (same address), Chad's Auto Repair vs Old Forge Services Center (same address) — possibly renames or moves.

Home-based operators (Bob Hoegler Plumbing, Mayer Plumbing, Warhaftig CPA, All-Wayz, Maximus) list residential-style addresses; only published business phone/address data was recorded, per the business-contact-only rule.

Excluded by rule and not listed: restaurants/cafes/bakeries/delis/pizzerias (Fiddleheads, Romeo's, The Diner, Nanami Sushi, La Placita, etc.), liquor stores, convenience/gas outlets (7-Eleven, QuickChek, Sunoco), pharmacies (CVS, Medscripts, Point of Care), banks (PNC, Provident, Citibank ATMs), chain self-storage (Extra Space/Life Storage, Public Storage), Concentra Urgent Care, Primerica, Snap Fitness, and places of worship.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass API was unreachable from this environment (connection failures on overpass-api.de and a mirror), so OSM business data could not be used.
YellowPages, BBB, SuperPages, Angi, Manta, ChamberOfCommerce.com, Cylex and LocalityBiz all returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks for direct fetches; only search-result snippets were usable.
Google Maps full result lists require sign-in ('limited view' cap of 5 results per query), so map-derived coverage is partial; queries were varied by category and map zoom to widen it.
Central NJ Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory (cnjrchamber.org) is JavaScript-rendered and returned only 'Loading...' / incomplete text — member list not retrieved.
Borough of Jamesburg website returned no server-rendered content, so no official licensed-business or economic-development list was available.

Phone numbers not captured for several small industrial/contractor listings (Savona Printing, Sweet Sign Systems, Molintex, Nu Lab, Lab-Tech, Alert Sprinkler, GWS, Firstline Locksmith, Thompson Bark, Stage Door Studio, Monroe French Cleaners).
